title: Add Alpine/OpenRC log rotation and rework rotation approach
description: Follow-up to smarthome-scripts-2o2: user also runs the bridge under Alpine/OpenRC with output_log/error_log pointing at /var/log/${RC_SVCNAME}.log|.err. Removed the app-level RotatingFileHandler/${'/tmp/atvbridge.log'} entirely — the script now only logs to stdout/stderr, and each platform's service manager (launchd on macOS, OpenRC on Alpine) is solely responsible for capturing and rotating logs (newsyslog vs logrotate). Added scripts/atv-mqtt.logrotate and documented an example OpenRC init script + install steps in README.

title: Add log file rotation to atv_mqtt_bridge.py
description: The bridge writes to /tmp/atvbridge.log via a plain logging.FileHandler, which grows unbounded since the process runs continuously under launchd (KeepAlive). Switch to RotatingFileHandler (size-based) so the log file is capped and rotated.
close_reason: RotatingFileHandler für atvbridge.log eingebaut; newsyslog.conf für launchd stdout/stderr ergänzt

title: Hard-pin Python dependencies for exact recovery
description: Created requirements.txt pinning pyatv, paho-mqtt and their full transitive runtime dependency tree to exact installed versions (Python 3.9.6), so a recovery/reinstall reproduces the exact working environment. Documented install step in README.md.
close_reason: requirements.txt created and validated with pip dry-run against current environment
